title: Concrete common-stage open pullback/tensor representative compatibility
statement: For finite-field data D, coefficient data C, common stages H, finite coefficient field E, compactified square Q, and rational inputs M,N on Q.Z, the inclusion of E satisfies the forward open pullback/tensor representative equation: inclusion maps the rational open tensor/pullback comparison, then the common tensorator and common pullback, equal the common comparison at the rational tensor followed by the common tensorator at the pullback and the common open tensor/pullback comparison. The exact Lean endpoints are the statement of commonProjectionOpenPullbackTensor_forward_compatibility.

source.place: Compatibility and the common finite coefficient-field paragraph: evaluate the canonical common-stage pullback/tensor representative at the included pair and cancel the transition maps and scalar unit.

proof.text: Normalize the rational and common tensorators and pullback comparisons. Evaluate the canonical common-stage pullback/tensor representative formula at the finite coefficient field E and the included pair M,N. The scalar unit and transition isomorphisms cancel by naturality, yielding the displayed forward equation.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility paragraph; finite-stage representative equation for the open tensor/pullback square.

theorem commonProjectionOpenPullbackTensor_forward_compatibility
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    (H : SixFunctorCommonStages D C)
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar)
    (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D)
    (M N : sfRationalConstructibleCategory C.l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient C.l C.Qbar E) Q.Z.obj.left) :
    (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
        (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Q.X.obj.left) E).map
        (((H.coefficientStages E).rationalExchange Q).openTensorPullback.hom.app M |>.app N) ≫
      (commonProjectionTensorComparison H E Q.X).hom.app
        ((H.coefficientStages E).rational.pull Q.i |>.obj M,
          (H.coefficientStages E).rational.pull Q.i |>.obj N) ≫
      (Functor.uncurry.obj (H.commonStageTensor Q.X)).map
        (Prod.mkHom
          (((H.commonStageComparison E).directAdjunction Q.i).left.hom.app M)
          (((H.commonStageComparison E).directAdjunction Q.i).left.hom.app N)) =
    (((H.commonStageComparison E).directAdjunction Q.i).left.hom.app
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj ((H.coefficientStages E).rationalTensor Q.Z)).obj (M, N))) ≫
      (H.commonStage.pull Q.i).map
        ((commonProjectionTensorComparison H E Q.Z).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
      (((H.commonStageExchange Q).openTensorPullback.hom.app
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Q.Z.obj.left) E).obj M)).app
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Q.Z.obj.left) E).obj N))
